questions.title: What do you do if you accidentally move your ball on the green?
questions.question: You are on the green and your ball rolls away because you touched it by mistake, like with your club. What should you do next?

choices.text: Hit the ball from where it rolled to, no penalty
Put the ball back where it was, no penalty
Put the ball back and add a penalty stroke
Leave the ball there and miss your go

questions.explanation: If you move your ball by accident on the green, you do not get a penalty. You just have to put the ball back where it was before it moved and then carry on playing.

vocabulary.simpleMeaning: The soft, short grass around the hole where you putt your ball.
Extra shots added to your score for breaking a rule.

questions.teachingTip: Show kids an example by rolling a ball with a club and explaining why it must go back to the same spot on the green.
likelyMisconceptions: Some think they can just play from the new spot.
Others may think they always get a penalty.
Some might try to skip their turn or just leave the ball.

questions.title: What happens if you accidentally move your ball on the green?
questions.question: If you accidentally move your ball on the green, like while taking a practice swing too close to it, what must you do next?

choices.text: Play the ball from its new position, no penalty
Replace the ball to its original spot, no penalty
Replace the ball and add a penalty stroke
Leave the ball and skip your turn

questions.explanation: If you accidentally move your ball on the green, there is no penalty but you must put it back to its original spot before continuing.
